title: Ground-truth workbook contains inconsistent cached values and fails its own verifier
evidence: The verifier recalculates the submitted workbook but compares it against unrecalculated golden caches. Those caches contradict the golden formulas: LBO!L103 contains '=+L135' but caches 1367.25404570845, while L135 caches 1373.2405637618; G124 contains '=+G133' but caches 302.331140639508 versus G133's 302.546887790176. Recalculating the golden workbook through the verifier's own recalculation helper and scoring it against the configured reference and golden files produces regression 1.0000, modification 0.9117, and 34 cell errors. For example, LBO!L199 is expected to equal 22.2666028507447 but recalculates to 6.14157343341685. Because the sole verifier requires every modification cell to match and carries weight 1, even the recalculated golden solution receives zero credit.
confirmation: Confirmed: L103 '=+L135' caches 1367.254 vs L135 1373.241, and G124 '=+G133' caches 302.331 vs 302.547. The inconsistent golden caches fail the sole weight-1 verifier (GT replay 0.00).
fix: Same golden cache fix (L103 = L135, G124 = G133).

title: The ground-truth workbook's cached values are internally inconsistent (the circular revolver/interest roll-forward does not tie), so the golden fails its own verifier after LibreOffice recalculation and the task cannot be passed
evidence:
Same issue reported 2 times, differing only in the verifier/range/step cited:
- This is the only verifier (weight 1, all-or-nothing). Before comparing, verify_spreadsheetbench2_cells recalculates the output in LibreOffice (force_recalculation=True) and requires 100% of modification cells to match. I copied gt_09_golden.xlsx to an output path and ran it through the real verifier. It returned score=0.0: 'FAILED - regression 1.0000, modification 0.9117. 34 cell error(s)'. Examples: LBO!I138 answer=1034.97 vs recalculated 1005.65; LBO!K138 698.75 vs 606.18; LBO!L199 22.27 vs 6.14; LBO!N201 422.33 vs 411.07; LBO!D213 '6% / 1.4x' vs '6% / 1.3x'. The model has a circular interes
- Cached values in gt_09_golden.xlsx, LBO sheet: H132 '=G135' is cached as 302.3311, but G135 is cached as 302.5469. I132 '=H135' is cached as 574.8275, but H135 is 575.6796. J132 '=I135' is 792.5734, but I135 is 794.3471. H138 '=IF($F138-H135<0,0,$F138-H135)' with F138=1800 and H135=575.68 should be 1224.32, but it is cached as 1233.10. So each period's opening revolver balance does not equal the prior period's closing balance in the answer key. Every graded modification cell downstream of the revolver (draws, unused fees, interest, cash flow, IRR/MOIC text in D213/L213) is keyed to stale numbe
confirmation: Golden LBO!H132 '=G135' cached 302.3311 vs G135 302.5469, and K138 cached 698.75 though F138 (1800) - K135 (1193.82) = 606.18. The revolver roll-forward does not tie, so the golden fails its own recalc-then-compare verifier.
fix: Same golden cache fix: opening revolver balances now equal prior closing balances; D213/L213 read '6% / 1.3x'.

title: Ground-truth workbook has unconverged circular-reference cached values and fails its own value-mode verifier
evidence: In `spec.yaml`, `SpreadsheetBench 2 official cell check` (`verify_spreadsheetbench2_cells`, weight: 1) grades in `mode: values` by force-recalculating the agent's output in LibreOffice (`managed_recalculated_xlsx(..., force_recalculation=True)`) and requiring 100% match on all 385 modification cells against the static cached values in `gt_09_golden.xlsx` (`reg_ratio == 1.0 and mod_ratio == 1.0`). However, the LBO model contains circular references (`iterate="true"` in `xl/workbook.xml`: Revolver Draw `G133:N133` -> Ending Revolver `G135:N135` -> Revolver Interest `G136:N136` -> Total Interest `G175:N175` -> Total Interest Expense `G179:N179` -> Less: Interest `G67:N67` -> Net Income `G69:N69` -> FCF `G99:N99` -> Cash Flow before Revolver `G123:N123`), and `gt_09_golden.xlsx` was saved in an unconverged state where same-row/upstream references hold stale pre-iteration cached values: for example, `LBO!H124` (`=+H133`) has cached value `272.496372058257` while `LBO!H133` in the same file has cached value `273.348432267803`; `LBO!H132` (`=G135`) has cached value `302.331140639508` while `LBO!G135` has `302.546887790176`; and `LBO!K138` (`=IF($F138-K135<0,0,$F138-K135)` with `F138=1800` and `K135=1193.82197`) has cached value `698.746838` instead of `1800 - 1193.82197 = 606.178030`. Running `verify_spreadsheetbench2_cells` on `gt_09_golden.xlsx` itself scores `0.0` (`FAILED - regression 1.0000, modification 0.9117. 34 cell error(s): Modification error at LBO!D213: answer=6% / 1.4x, output=6% / 1.3x; Modification error at LBO!H204: answer=0.00413401166586813, output=0.00406107965098057; Modification error at LBO!I138: answer=1034.97097384539, output=1005.65291449478...`), whereas in `formula` mode it scores `1.0` (`(1.0, 1.0, [])`). Furthermore, one single LibreOffice conversion pass starting from the input file's cached values does not even converge the multi-year circular chain (taking 4 passes to settle). Thus no submission can ever pass `verify_spreadsheetbench2_cells` in `values` mode.
confirmation: workbook.xml has calcPr iterate=true, and the golden caches are unconverged: H132 '=G135' caches 302.331 vs G135 302.547, and K138 caches 698.75 vs 606.18. All-or-nothing values-mode grading against these caches is impossible to pass.
fix: Same golden cache fix (e.g. H124 now equals H133, K138 = 1800 - K135).

title: Golden gate: the ground-truth deliverable does not score full reward
evidence: The ground-truth deliverable, staged at the verifiers' own output paths and graded by the problem's real grader, scored 0.00 (need >= 1.00). A correct answer that does not earn full reward means a verifier false-negatives the mandated work. With the ground truth staged, every one of the 1 checks on /home/model/Desktop/output.xlsx scored 0 (summed weight 1.000), which is the whole shortfall of the GT grade. A correct deliverable does not fail every check at once; the ground truth for this file most likely never reached the grader (paired with a file of another type or name), so these are not 1 separate verifier defects. Checks: SpreadsheetBench 2 official cell check.
confirmation: The GT scored 0.00. gt_09_golden.xlsx (iterate=true circular LBO) holds unconverged caches, e.g. LBO!H124 '=+H133' cached 272.496 while H133 = 273.348, and K138 cached 698.75 vs 1800-1193.82 = 606.18, so the recalculated output cannot match the static golden values.
fix: gt_09_golden.xlsx: cached values of 257 formula cells on LBO (circular revolver block and its downstream rows, incl. 132-138, 175-201, D213/L213) set to the converged values (recalculated until stable). Golden now scores 1.0 locally (regression 1.0, modification 1.0). The 388 circular LBO cells that do not settle in one LibreOffice recalculation (from an openpyxl-saved output or from the input's unconverged caches) are also left out of answer_position and the guidance range text, so the result no longer depends on how the output was saved. Real SB2 scorer: golden 1.0, golden re-saved with openpyxl 1.0, input + key formulas saved with openpyxl 1.0, untouched input fails (mod 0.05; the G66:N66 and Financials row 18 fixes stay graded).

title: SpreadsheetBench 2 official cell check: verify_spreadsheetbench2_cells is a trivial fail because recalculating the golden workbook in LibreOffice diverges from its unconverged cached values
evidence: `SpreadsheetBench 2 official cell check` (`verify_spreadsheetbench2_cells`, weight: 1) scored 0.0 on all 3 units (unit 1: regression 0.9831, modification 0.0935; unit 2: regression 0.9862, modification 0.2026; unit 3: regression 0.9790, modification 0.2208). While all 3 units also missed at least one of the 4 intended formula edits (unit 1 only fixed `Financials!J18:N18`; units 2 and 3 fixed `Financials!J18:N18`, `LBO!G69:N69`, and `LBO!G175:N175` but set `LBO!G66:N66` to `Core EBIT` without `+G75`), the verifier is incapable of passing even a 100% identical golden workbook: `verify_spreadsheetbench2_cells` force-recalculates `output_path` once in LibreOffice (`managed_recalculated_xlsx(Path(output_path), force_recalculation=True)`), but compares it against the raw cached values in `gt_09_golden.xlsx` without recalculating `gt_path`. Because `gt_09_golden.xlsx` has unconverged circular-reference cached values (e.g. `LBO!H124` is `=H133` with cached value `272.496` while `H133` is `273.348`, and `LBO!K138` is `=IF($F138-K135<0,0,$F138-K135)` with cached value `698.747` instead of `1800 - 1193.822 = 606.178`), evaluating `gt_09_golden.xlsx` against itself scores `0.0` (`FAILED - regression 1.0000, modification 0.9117. 34 cell error(s)`), and applying the exact 29 golden formula fixes to the input workbook and running `verify_spreadsheetbench2_cells` also scores `0.0` (`FAILED - regression 0.9829, modification 0.2052. 410 cell error(s)` after 1 LibreOffice pass, or `modification 0.9091` after 4 passes).
confirmation: Confirmed stale circular caches in the golden (H124 vs H133, K138 698.75 vs 606.18). The values-mode verifier recalculates only the output and compares it to these caches, so even the golden fails (GT replay 0.00).
fix: Same golden cache fix; the verifier compares against converged values that a single forced recalculation of the golden reproduces. The 388 circular LBO cells that do not settle in one LibreOffice recalculation (from an openpyxl-saved output or from the input's unconverged caches) are also left out of answer_position and the guidance range text, so the result no longer depends on how the output was saved. Real SB2 scorer: golden 1.0, golden re-saved with openpyxl 1.0, input + key formulas saved with openpyxl 1.0, untouched input fails (mod 0.05; the G66:N66 and Financials row 18 fixes stay graded).
